title: Walkthrough journey (journey.yaml)
description:
An ordered compilation of already-produced feature videos stitched into ONE end-to-end walkthrough. Reuses each feature's generated/final-video.mp4 — nothing is re-recorded. Lives at

/journeys//journey.yaml; the build writes generated/journey.mp4 (gitignored).

id.description: kebab-case; matches the journeys/<id>/ folder name.

businessValue.description: What the whole tour demonstrates, for the viewer.

segments.description: Feature videos to stitch, in play order. Any module — a journey is the whole-app tour.

feature.description: <module>/<feature> under this project, e.g. users/view-users-list. Its final-video.mp4 is the segment source.

fromShot.description: Trim the segment to START at this shot (drops earlier shots — e.g. skip a repeated sign-in on a later segment). Default: whole feature. First segment usually keeps its login; later ones set fromShot past it.

toShot.description: Trim the segment to END after this shot. Default: to the feature's end.

contentHash.description: Hash of journey.yaml (excluding status) at last build.
